arStrings.szText: "Your vision—you saw some of it. What exactly did you see?"
Eyes in the dark. A hunger that has no mouth. Silence. A crownless king. A conqueror welcomed with open arms. I have to hold onto it!
Increasingly intense as she describes the horrible visions she saw.
Focus! Feel your breath. The cloth on your skin.
A steadying command to pull the other character (Athrpa) back from a panic attack.

It was the clearest I have ever seen. The images had come into focus. Clear as you stand before me now. But just as it was there, it was gone. I can still taste it. Like ash. Human flesh. Ruin. Something vast behind the sun.
Deep breath at start. Haunted and shaken.
